title: Israeli forces launch second major raid on Al-Shifa Hospital
body:
On 18 March 2024, Israeli forces raided Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City again, starting at about 2 a.m. GMT with tanks and heavy gunfire. Al Jazeera described it as the fourth Israeli raid on the hospital since 7 October. The Israeli military called it a precise operation and said Hamas had regrouped inside the hospital and was using it to command attacks on Israel. Hamas denies using hospitals for military purposes.

Spokesman Daniel Hagari said the military would provide food and water and that patients and staff had no obligation to evacuate. The Israeli military reported one soldier killed, Staff Sergeant Matan Vinogradov, 20, bringing the number of Israeli soldiers killed in the war to 250. Leaflets directed civilians near the hospital to the al-Mawasi zone in Khan Younis.

Gaza's Ministry of Health said about 30,000 people, including displaced civilians, wounded patients and medical staff, were trapped inside and that anyone trying to move was targeted by snipers and quadcopters. The Government Media Office condemned the raid as a war crime. Al Jazeera Arabic reported that the surgical building was on fire and that its correspondent Ismail al-Ghoul was beaten and arrested inside the hospital. The UN, as cited by Al Jazeera, said 155 health facilities in Gaza had been damaged since the war began.
